brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis in Jerusalem on Monday that Israel is "fighting the battle of Western civilisation," Middle East Eye reported. The two leaders met at a time of heightened regional tensions.

Netanyahu has repeatedly cast Israel's military operations in terms that extend beyond territorial disputes, positioning the country as a defender of broader geopolitical interests and values.
dek: Netanyahu claims Israel’s ‘fighting’ battle for Western civilisation Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, speaking alongside Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis in Jerusalem on Monday, said that Israel is "fighting the battle of Western civilisation".
title: Netanyahu says Israel fights for Western civilization
